data.review_body:
Urgent Demand for Immediate Refund!

This level of irresponsibility and gross violation of consumer rights goes beyond all limits! This is by far the worst and most severe experience I have ever had on this platform.

The situation is as follows:

Deceptive Delivery Times: I placed the order on July 6. The website clearly stated that delivery in Georgia would take 2 working days, but in reality, the items were only delivered on July 12.

Damaged and Defective Goods: The items arrived completely damaged and stained.

Ignorance and Delays: Ever since July 12, I have continuously requested a refund, but instead of a resolution, I am met with confusion and stalling. Neither has a courier come to pick up the items, nor has my money been refunded.

I Demand:

An immediate, unconditional refund for both orders.

That you stop harassing me with courier calls and empty promises.

If this matter is not resolved in the shortest possible time, I will be forced to publicize this case on international consumer platforms and formally appeal to consumer protection organizations!

data.review_body:
It's impossible to contact you via chat. Only robots respond. Open tickets are closed by agents who don't even understand what's going on! I'm specifically talking about a phone holder for a telescope. I'm tired of showing photos from the warehouse where the camera shows two items, but they refund only one. But in the ticket, the agent writes that after checking, I was only refunded for the item that arrived at the warehouse! What kind of verification? Why did you install a camera if, with camera data, you still claim the item is missing, even though the camera shows two items!!! I won't waste my energy anymore. I'll simply take this matter to court!
 PO-014-15805518213750926  I am writing this review out of utter frustration with this company's non-existent warranty and terrible customer support.
I ordered two phone holders for a telescope (one for myself and one as a gift). Since the quality was disappointing, I followed their instructions and returned the items — in the exact same condition I received them. However, the warehouse only refunded me for ONE item instead of two!
What makes this even worse is that the warehouse’s own photos and video proof clearly show BOTH items present in my returned package. Despite this obvious evidence, support has been dragging their feet for over two weeks, sending me automated template responses claiming they are "waiting for a reply from the warehouse."
It is no surprise that countries everywhere are fining your company and people are boycotting you due to an endless flood of complaints. You advertise warranties and protection, but in reality, you violate customer rights and withhold money that isn't yours. Take real measures to fix your business operations or just close your shop down entirely!
I demand an immediate refund for my second item. I refuse to ever order from this platform again. Stop sending useless templates and give me my money back!
